label.zh-TW: 期末現金及約當現金餘額
label.en: Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period

teacherLabel: 期末現金及約當現金餘額
currentTwLabel: 期末現金及約當現金餘額
ifrsEnglish: Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period

definition.zh-TW: 期初現金加上本期增減額之後，期末還剩多少現金。這個數字要和資產負債表左上角「現金及約當現金」那一列的餘額一模一樣（步驟③，勾稽點 C）。
definition.en: Opening cash plus the period’s net change: how much cash is left at the end. This figure must be identical to the cash and cash equivalents line at the top of the balance sheet (step 3, check C).
